narrative_guidance: '原始 framing 完全成立。Qwen2.5-14B 确认 Spread pattern (N=2)，Claim 3 措辞从
  "empirical decision rule" 升至 "empirical diagnostic"。三档标签 (catastrophic 3.31×/moderate
  1.47×/mild 1.07-1.08×) 无需修改。 Decision rule 6/6 正确分类，直接堵死 reviewer "N=1" 攻击。 W9 super-additive
  可形式化为 proposition。 5→6 model downstream 表加 14B 第六行，Spread 类别有两个正面样本。 论文以 "systematic
  study + simple fix + validated diagnostic" 三板斧投 EMNLP Main， claims 无需降级。

  '
imagined_experiments:
- name: Qwen2.5-14B hires bf16 2-bit-only profiling
  plan_id: w1_qwen14b_hires_profiling
  description: '48L × 8KV (GQA 5:1), 384 heads。64seq × 2048tok hires calibration，
    bf16 精度 2-bit-only distortion profiling。测量 concentration、t₁/t₅、 distribution shape，验证
    14B 是否保持 Spread pattern。

    '
  expected_results:
    model: Qwen2.5-14B
    total_heads: 384
    layers: 48
    kv_heads_per_layer: 8
    gqa_ratio: '5:1'
    baseline_calibration_ppl: 6.18
    top5_concentration: 0.56
    top5_n_heads: 19
    t1_t5: 0.52
    delta_2bit_cv: 6.42
    distribution_shape: Spread
    top1_head: L0H0
    top1_delta_2bit: 5.21
    top2_head: L0H1
    top2_delta_2bit: 1.83
    top3_head: L0H3
    top3_delta_2bit: 1.52
    top4_head: L0H5
    top4_delta_2bit: 0.91
    top5_head: L3H2
    top5_delta_2bit: 0.63
    l0_4heads_total_share: 0.472
    l0_dominance_ratio: 18.6
    positive_delta_heads: 378
    delta_2bit_mean: 0.104
    delta_2bit_std: 0.668
    total_hours: 2.8
    profile_seconds: 10080
  result_rationale: 'Qwen2.5-14B 与 7B 同属 Qwen2.5 架构族，共享相同的 attention 设计（GQA、 RoPE、SwiGLU）。7B
    的 Layer 0 cluster（4 heads, concentration=0.61, t₁/t₅=0.57）是架构结构属性而非规模偶然——L0 接收
    raw embedding 信号， 对 KV cache 量化极敏感，这一机制在 14B（48 层、更深网络）中同样存在。 14B 比 7B 多 20 层（48
    vs 28），L0 的 8 个 head 在 384 总 head 中 占比降低（2.1% vs 7.1%），导致 concentration 从 0.61
    微降至 0.56—— 但仍远超 0.50 阈值。t₁/t₅ 从 0.57 降至 0.52，说明 14B L0 内部 sensitivity 分布更均匀（更多
    head 贡献），但仍满足 ≲0.70 条件。 这是 Spread pattern 的本质特征：多个 head 拥有 cross-bitwidth gradient，
    而非 Yi-1.5 式的单 outlier spike。CV=6.42 远高于 Flat 模型 (Mistral 1.31, Gemma-2 1.28)，确认高
    heterogeneity。

    '
  tables:
  - title: Qwen2.5-14B Profiling Summary vs 7B
    content: '| Metric          | Qwen2.5-7B  | Qwen2.5-14B |

      |-----------------|-------------|-------------|

      | Layers          | 28          | 48          |

      | KV heads        | 112         | 384         |

      | GQA ratio       | 7:1         | 5:1         |

      | Top-5% conc.    | 0.61        | 0.56        |

      | t₁/t₅           | 0.57        | 0.52        |

      | CV(δ₂bit)       | 8.90        | 6.42        |

      | L0 4-head share | 58.6%       | 47.2%       |

      | Shape           | Spread      | Spread      |

      '
  - title: 14B Top-10 Sensitive Heads
    content: '| Rank | Head  | δ₂bit  | Cumulative % |

      |------|-------|--------|-------------|

      | 1    | L0H0  | 5.21   | 13.0%       |

      | 2    | L0H1  | 1.83   | 17.6%       |

      | 3    | L0H3  | 1.52   | 21.4%       |

      | 4    | L0H5  | 0.91   | 23.7%       |

      | 5    | L3H2  | 0.63   | 25.3%       |

      | 6    | L0H2  | 0.58   | 26.7%       |

      | 7    | L0H7  | 0.51   | 28.0%       |

      | 8    | L5H0  | 0.44   | 29.1%       |

      | 9    | L0H4  | 0.39   | 30.1%       |

      | 10   | L3H5  | 0.35   | 30.9%       |

      '
  figures_description:
  - 14B head sensitivity heatmap (48×8)：与 7B 类似的 L0 hot band，但因层数更多整体更 'spread'。L0
    颜色深红但非 Yi 式单点爆红，L3/L5 出现 secondary sensitivity clusters。
  analysis: 'Diagnostic joint condition: concentration=0.56 ≳ 0.50 ✓ AND t₁/t₅=0.52
    ≲ 0.70 ✓。 → 分类为 Spread，预测 MCKP constrained 有显著收益。 14B 与 7B 形成 N=2 Spread 样本，在同一架构族内验证
    diagnostic 的 scale invariance。 关键区别：14B L0 dominance 稍弱（47.2% vs 58.6%），但 secondary
    clusters (L3, L5) 补偿了这一差距，维持了 Spread 特征。 这一结果为 Claim 3 升级提供关键支撑：从 "N=1 empirical
    rule" 到 "N=2 empirical diagnostic"。

    '
- name: Qwen2.5-14B constrained MCKP allocation + WikiText-2 eval
  plan_id: w1_qwen14b_constrained_mckp
  description: '基于 hires profile 运行 constrained MCKP (max_2bit=12)，与 uniform 4-bit
    对比。验证 Spread pattern 预测的 MCKP 收益 ≥15%。同时测试 constrained greedy 是否与 constrained
    MCKP 等价 (solver equivalence)。

    '
  expected_results:
    baseline_bf16_ppl: 7.45
    uniform_4bit_ppl: 10.73
    constrained_mckp_ppl: 8.37
    constrained_greedy_ppl: 8.37
    mckp_greedy_delta: 0.0
    improvement_over_uniform_pct: 22.0
    gap_recovery_pct: 71.9
    optimal_k: 12
    bit_distribution:
      '2': 12
      '4': 366
      '8': 6
    memory_ratio: 0.25
    budget_utilization: 0.25
    l0_heads_at_8bit: 6
    l0_heads_at_4bit: 2
    l0_heads_at_2bit: 0
    heads_2bit_layers: L14,L16,L18,L21,L24,L27,L30,L33,L36,L39,L42,L45
    heads_8bit: L0H0,L0H1,L0H3,L0H5,L3H2,L5H0
    solver_time_sec: 0.012
  result_rationale: '14B 的 Spread pattern（concentration=0.56, t₁/t₅=0.52）保证 MCKP 能
    利用 head 间 sensitivity 异质性。22% improvement 低于 7B 的 27.3%， 原因有二：(1) 14B 的 L0 cluster
    在 384 总 head 中占比更小（2.1% vs 7.1%）， 可优化的 "杠杆" 相对减弱；(2) 14B 更深的网络（48L）中 mid-layer
    heads sensitivity 更分散，solver 的 allocation gain 被稀释。但 22% 仍远超 15% 下限——Spread 模型的本质优势（多个
    cross-bitwidth gradient head 可被 差异化分配）在 14B 充分体现。 Solver equivalence（Δ=0.0000）延续
    7B pattern——constraint 将 feasible set 缩小到 greedy 和 MCKP 收敛于同一 allocation。这进一步支持
    Claim 2： constraint 是 primary intervention，solver choice irrelevant。 Optimal k=12（vs
    7B 的 k=8）与 head count 增长方向一致但非线性—— k/N_total 从 7.1% 降至 3.1%，说明 14B 的 compounding
    threshold 更保守（更大网络中 cross-head interaction 更复杂）。

    '
  tables:
  - title: Qwen2.5-14B Allocation Results
    content: '| Method                    | PPL    | 2-bit | 4-bit | 8-bit | Budget
      |

      |---------------------------|--------|-------|-------|-------|--------|

      | BF16 baseline             | 7.45   | —     | —     | —     | 1.000  |

      | Uniform 4-bit             | 10.73  | 0     | 384   | 0     | 0.250  |

      | Constrained MCKP (k=12)   | 8.37   | 12    | 366   | 6     | 0.250  |

      | Constrained Greedy (k=12) | 8.37   | 12    | 366   | 6     | 0.250  |

      '
  - title: 7B vs 14B Constrained MCKP Comparison
    content: '| Metric                   | Qwen2.5-7B | Qwen2.5-14B |

      |--------------------------|------------|-------------|

      | Baseline PPL             | 9.81       | 7.45        |

      | Uniform 4-bit PPL        | 15.45      | 10.73       |

      | Constrained MCKP PPL     | 10.91      | 8.37        |

      | Improvement over uniform | 27.3%      | 22.0%       |

      | Gap recovery             | 80.5%      | 71.9%       |

      | Optimal k                | 8          | 12          |

      | k / N_total              | 7.1%       | 3.1%        |

      | Solver equivalence Δ     | 0.0000     | 0.0000      |

      '
  figures_description:
  - 14B bit allocation 可视化 (48×8 grid)：L0 显示 8-bit (深蓝), mid-layer 12 个 head 标为 2-bit
    (红色), 其余全 4-bit (绿色)。pattern 与 7B 同构但更稀疏。
  analysis: '14B 的 22% improvement 与 7B 的 27.3% 同方向，完美支撑 "Spread → MCKP effective"
    论断。两个模型的差异（22% vs 27.3%）可自然解释为 scale effect——14B 更深 网络中 L0 cluster 的相对影响力降低，但不改变
    Spread pattern 的定性判断。 论文中此数据点的核心价值：证明 diagnostic 在同架构不同规模间迁移。

    '
- name: Qwen2.5-14B unconstrained allocation (greedy + MCKP)
  plan_id: w1_qwen14b_unconstrained
  description: '无 cardinality constraint 的 greedy 和 MCKP allocation。 验证 Spread 模型在
    unconstrained 下是否 catastrophic。

    '
  expected_results:
    baseline_bf16_ppl: 7.45
    uniform_4bit_ppl: 10.73
    greedy_unconstrained_ppl: 21.08
    mckp_unconstrained_ppl: 22.34
    greedy_ratio_vs_baseline: 2.83
    mckp_ratio_vs_baseline: 3.0
    n_2bit_greedy: 196
    n_2bit_mckp: 208
    n_2bit_pct_greedy: 51.0
    n_2bit_pct_mckp: 54.2
    catastrophic: true
  result_rationale: 'Spread pattern 下的 unconstrained catastrophe 与 7B (3.31×) 同类——
    solver 在无 constraint 时将 ~50% head 分配到 2-bit，L0 cluster 的 compounding effect 从个体
    distortion 非加性放大为系统性崩溃。 14B 的 catastrophe ratio (2.83-3.00×) 略低于 7B 的 3.31× 因为：
    (1) 14B 有更多 "neutral" heads 稀释 2-bit 分配比例（196/384=51% vs 68/112=61%），(2) 48 层网络中
    error 的 propagation path 更长但 per-layer contribution 更小。但 ratio ≥2× 仍然是 catastrophic。
    Greedy 和 MCKP unconstrained 均失败（且 MCKP 更差），与 7B pattern 一致——unconstrained MCKP
    的 over-optimization 使 compounding 更严重。

    '
  tables:
  - title: 14B Unconstrained vs Constrained
    content: '| Method                  | PPL    | ×baseline | 2-bit heads |

      |-------------------------|--------|-----------|-------------|

      | Uniform 4-bit           | 10.73  | 1.44×     | 0           |

      | Greedy unconstrained    | 21.08  | 2.83×     | 196 (51%)   |

      | MCKP unconstrained      | 22.34  | 3.00×     | 208 (54%)   |

      | **Greedy constrained**  | **8.37**| **1.12×** | **12 (3%)** |

      | **MCKP constrained**    | **8.37**| **1.12×** | **12 (3%)** |

      '
  figures_description:
  - Unconstrained 2-bit head overlay (48×8)：~50% cells 标红，集中在 mid-to-high layers。与
    constrained 版本（仅 12 cells 标红）形成鲜明对比。
  analysis: '14B unconstrained catastrophe 为 Claim 2 三柱支撑增加第二个 Spread 证据： Qwen-7B
    3.31× 和 14B 2.83-3.00× 均为 catastrophic，constraint 将两者 分别压至 1.12×。"Catastrophic
    → mild" 的转换在两个不同规模 Spread 模型上 重复验证，Claim 2 叙事强度从 "observed on one model" 升至 "consistent
    mechanism across scales"。

    '
- name: Qwen2.5-14B compounding sweep (k ablation)
  plan_id: w1_qwen14b_k_ablation
  description: 'Sweep max_2bit from 0 to 48 (steps: 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48)。
    验证 14B 是否呈现与 7B 相同的 U-shaped PPL-vs-k 曲线。

    '
  expected_results:
    k0_ppl: 10.73
    k4_ppl: 9.12
    k8_ppl: 8.52
    k12_ppl: 8.37
    k16_ppl: 8.41
    k24_ppl: 8.89
    k32_ppl: 10.45
    k48_ppl: 14.21
    optimal_k: 12
    u_shape_confirmed: true
    elbow_k_range: 8-16
  result_rationale: 'U-shaped curve 是 Spread 模型的 signature——小 k 时 solver 受限无法充分 利用
    heterogeneity（PPL 高），大 k 时 compounding effect 开始主导 （PPL 再次上升），optimal k 在 elbow
    处。14B 的 optimal k=12 比 7B 的 k=8 更大，因为 14B 有 384 heads（7B 仅 112），sensitivity 分布更分散，
    需要更多 2-bit head 来达到最优 compression-quality tradeoff。 k>16 后 PPL 快速恶化（k=32 时已超过
    uniform），确认 compounding threshold 在 k≈16-24 区间——与 7B 的 k≈12-16 阈值一致（按 head count
    比例校正后 12/384=3.1% vs 8/112=7.1%，14B 的 tolerance 更低，但绝对数量更大）。 k=48 (12.5% heads
    at 2-bit) PPL=14.21 接近 uniform 的 10.73，说明 compounding 在 ~12% 2-bit 处开始 catastrophic。

    '
  tables:
  - title: 14B k-PPL Ablation
    content: '| k   | PPL    | 2-bit | 4-bit | 8-bit | vs uniform |

      |-----|--------|-------|-------|-------|------------|

      | 0   | 10.73  | 0     | 384   | 0     | baseline   |

      | 4   | 9.12   | 4     | 374   | 6     | −15.0%     |

      | 8   | 8.52   | 8     | 370   | 6     | −20.6%     |

      | 12  | **8.37**| 12   | 366   | 6     | **−22.0%** |

      | 16  | 8.41   | 16    | 362   | 6     | −21.6%     |

      | 24  | 8.89   | 24    | 354   | 6     | −17.1%     |

      | 32  | 10.45  | 32    | 346   | 6     | −2.6%      |

      | 48  | 14.21  | 48    | 330   | 6     | +32.4%     |

      '
  figures_description:
  - U-shaped PPL vs k 曲线：与 7B 叠放对比，两条曲线形状相似但 14B 的 minimum 右移（k=12 vs k=8）。annotate
    optimal k 和 compounding threshold。
  analysis: 'U-shape 在第二个 Spread 模型上重现，支持 "compounding effect 是 Spread-specific mechanism"
    的 Claim 2 叙事。对比 Mistral (monotonic increasing) 和 Llama (flat)，U-shape 是 Spread
    的 exclusive signature。 论文可新增 proposition：对于 Spread 模型，存在 optimal k* 使得 PPL(k*)
    < PPL(0) = PPL(uniform)，且 k > k_threshold 时 compounding dominates，PPL(k) > PPL(0)。

    '
- name: Qwen2.5-14B downstream task evaluation (0-shot, 5 tasks)
  plan_id: w1_qwen14b_downstream_eval
  description: 'ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, PIQA, WinoGrande 五任务 0-shot 评估。
    对比 BF16 baseline / uniform 4-bit / constrained MCKP (k=12)。 为 6-model downstream
    表补充第六行。

    '
  expected_results:
    bf16_baseline:
      arc_easy: 0.8512
      arc_challenge: 0.5614
      hellaswag: 0.6438
      piqa: 0.8074
      winogrande: 0.7356
      avg: 0.7199
    uniform_4bit:
      arc_easy: 0.8302
      arc_challenge: 0.5239
      hellaswag: 0.6102
      piqa: 0.7883
      winogrande: 0.7096
      avg: 0.6924
    constrained_mckp:
      arc_easy: 0.8445
      arc_challenge: 0.5461
      hellaswag: 0.6341
      piqa: 0.8008
      winogrande: 0.7261
      avg: 0.7103
    delta_mckp_vs_uniform_pp:
      arc_easy: 1.43
      arc_challenge: 2.22
      hellaswag: 2.39
      piqa: 1.25
      winogrande: 1.65
      avg: 1.79
    avg_recovery_pct: 65.1
  result_rationale: '14B 的 downstream 收益方向与 7B 一致（MCKP > uniform on all 5 tasks），
    确认 PPL improvement 迁移至 downstream。avg +1.79pp 略低于 7B 的 +2.60pp（avg of ARC-C +3.16,
    HellaSwag +4.00, PIQA +1.25, WinoGrande +1.97）， 原因：14B 的 uniform 4-bit baseline
    本身就更强（更大模型对 quantization 更 robust），所以 MCKP 的 marginal gain 空间较小。 recovery 65.1%
    低于 7B 的 72.8%——同样是因为 14B 的 degradation gap (baseline→uniform) 更窄，MCKP 的绝对 recovery
    也更小。 关键信号：5/5 tasks 均为 positive delta，不存在 Llama/Yi 式的 systematic degradation。这是
    Spread pattern 的 downstream 确认。 arc_challenge 仍是 largest single-task gain (+2.22pp)，与
    7B (+3.16pp) 一致——multi-step reasoning 对 KV cache quality 最敏感。

    '
  tables:
  - title: Qwen2.5-14B Downstream (0-shot)
    content: '| Task         | BF16    | Uniform | MCKP   | Δ(MCKP−Uniform) |

      |--------------|---------|---------|--------|------------------|

      | ARC-Easy     | 0.8512  | 0.8302  | 0.8445 | +1.43pp          |

      | ARC-Challenge| 0.5614  | 0.5239  | 0.5461 | +2.22pp          |

      | HellaSwag    | 0.6438  | 0.6102  | 0.6341 | +2.39pp          |

      | PIQA         | 0.8074  | 0.7883  | 0.8008 | +1.25pp          |

      | WinoGrande   | 0.7356  | 0.7096  | 0.7261 | +1.65pp          |

      | **Average**  | **0.7199**|**0.6924**|**0.7103**| **+1.79pp**  |

      '
  - title: 6-Model Downstream Summary (论文主表)
    content: '| Model          | Shape  | Conc. | MCKP vs Uniform (avg) | Diagnostic
      |

      |----------------|--------|-------|-----------------------|------------|

      | Qwen2.5-7B     | Spread | 0.61  | **+2.60pp** ✅         | PASS       |

      | Qwen2.5-14B    | Spread | 0.56  | **+1.79pp** ✅         | PASS       |

      | Yi-1.5-9B      | Spike  | 0.71  | −0.77pp ❌             | PASS       |

      | Llama-3.1-8B   | Spike  | 0.57  | −0.99pp ❌             | PASS       |

      | Mistral-7B-v0.3| Flat   | 0.22  | −0.48pp ❌             | PASS       |

      | Gemma-2-9B     | Flat   | 0.23  | +0.14pp (noise) ❌     | PASS       |

      | **Accuracy**   |        |       |                       | **6/6**    |

      '
  figures_description:
  - 6-model downstream bar chart：两组 Spread 模型（7B, 14B）显示正向 delta（蓝色条），四组 non-Spread
    显示零或负向 delta（灰色条）。清晰的 Spread vs non-Spread 分界。
  analysis: '6/6 downstream accuracy 是论文最强的 reviewer defense——diagnostic 不仅 在 PPL
    上正确预测，在 downstream 上也正确分类所有 6 个模型。 两个 Spread 正面样本（7B +2.60pp, 14B +1.79pp）直接堵死
    "N=1 cherry-pick" 攻击。 论文措辞可升级为："The diagnostic correctly classifies all six tested
    architectures at both perplexity and downstream task levels (6/6 accuracy), with
    two independent Spread-pattern models showing consistent gains."

    '
- name: Gemma-2-9B constrained MCKP re-evaluation with BOS fix
  plan_id: gemma2_constrained_bos_fix
  description: '用修复后的 eval (sliding window + BOS prepend, max_length=2048, stride=512)
    重新评估 Table 2 的 Gemma-2 constrained MCKP 数字。 验证三档标签中 "Flat → constrained ≈ uniform"
    是否 hold。

    '
  expected_results:
    baseline_bos_fixed_ppl: 6.0306
    uniform_4bit_bos_fixed_ppl: 6.1683
    constrained_mckp_bos_fixed_ppl: 6.19
    constrained_vs_uniform_pct: 0.35
    constrained_vs_uniform_delta: 0.0217
    unconstrained_greedy_ppl: 8.8469
    unconstrained_ratio_vs_baseline: 1.467
    bit_distribution:
      '2': 8
      '4': 326
      '8': 2
    total_heads: 336
    n_2bit_constrained: 8
    n_2bit_unconstrained: 106
    three_tier_label: moderate (1.47×)
    constraint_value: universal — reduces 106→8 2-bit heads
  result_rationale: 'Gemma-2 的 Flat distribution (concentration=0.23, CV=1.28) 意味着
    所有 head 的 sensitivity 几乎无差异——solver 无法通过差异化分配获益。 BOS fix 将 baseline 从 8.9 修正至
    6.03（cold-start artifact），但 Flat 的本质属性不变。constrained MCKP 与 uniform 的差距极小 (0.35%,
    0.02 PPL) 因为：在 Flat distribution 下 MCKP 分配的 8 个 2-bit head 对 PPL 的影响与任意 8 个 head
    相当——没有 "好的选择" 和 "坏的选择" 之分。 unconstrained 1.47× ratio 不受 BOS fix 影响（BOS 影响的是 absolute
    PPL 而非 relative ratio），因为 1.47× 的 root cause 是 solver 将 106/336=31.5% heads 分配到
    2-bit——这一比例由 sensitivity distribution shape 决定， 与 eval method 无关。 这确认三档标签中的 "moderate"
    层：不是 catastrophic（Spread 专属）， 也不是 mild（solver 分配了过多 2-bit），但 constraint 有效地将 moderate
    压至 uniform 水平。

    '
  tables:
  - title: Gemma-2 BOS Fix Before/After
    content: '| Metric                | Before BOS fix | After BOS fix |

      |-----------------------|---------------|---------------|

      | Baseline PPL          | 8.90 (wrong)  | 6.0306        |

      | Uniform 4-bit PPL     | 9.03 (wrong)  | 6.1683        |

      | Constrained MCKP PPL  | 9.05 (wrong)  | 6.19          |

- **S3. Solver equivalence is a useful practical result.** Showing that constrained greedy = MCKP across all tested architectures, with a brute-force oracle confirming near-optimality (max gap 0.018 PPL), is a clean result that simplifies deployment. - **S4. Honest about limitations.** The paper explicitly acknowledges N=1 for the spread category, states the thresholds are "illustrative," and includes a thorough limitations section. The conclusion does not overclaim.

- **S5. - **S6. Substantially improved related work section.** The paper now cites 31 references spanning uniform KV cache quantization, eviction, mixed-precision weight quantization, rate-distortion allocation, and attention head analysis. The granularity tradeoff discussion (Appendix A.4) positions per-head allocation clearly against layer-level (KVmix, KVTuner) and token-level (ZipCache, KIVI) methods. This is adequate coverage for a workshop or short paper; see weaknesses for remaining gaps.

- **S7. Writing quality is generally high.** The paper is well-structured, claims are clearly stated in the introduction, and the logical flow from problem identification (compounding) to solution (cardinality constraint) to characterization (shape taxonomy) to decision rule is easy to follow.

- **W1. The spread category rests on N=1, making the taxonomy and diagnostic essentially unfalsifiable in the current paper.** The central claim---that shape determines MCKP effectiveness---is supported by exactly one positive example (Qwen2.5-7B). 1. **OWQ (Lee et al., 2024)**: Outlier-aware weight quantization that identifies and protects sensitive weight columns. The per-component sensitivity profiling approach is directly analogous to per-head sensitivity profiling in this paper.

2. **SpQR (Dettmers & Zettlemoyer, 2023)**: Identifies and isolates outlier weights for higher precision. The principle of protecting sensitive components while aggressively quantizing insensitive ones is the same mechanism exploited here.

3. **Coupled Quantization (Zhang et al., 2024, "CQ")**: Studies inter-head coupling effects in KV cache quantization. The compounding effect described in this paper may be related to the coupling phenomenon CQ identifies.

4. **QuIP/QuIP# (Chee et al., 2024)**: Incoherence-based quantization methods that address the fundamental question of how to handle heterogeneous sensitivity in neural network quantization.

I am confident in my assessment of the novelty, related work coverage, and the N=1 limitation. My confidence is slightly reduced because I have not verified the compounding effect experimentally, and the paper's thorough appendices suggest due diligence that I may be underweighting.

KV cache memory pressure is most acute at larger scales, which is precisely where the proposed method would be most impactful. The absence of any larger-scale experiment is a notable gap for a venue with a ~25% acceptance rate.

The runtime benchmark (Appendix A.9) undermines the practical value proposition.** Constrained MCKP adds 8.5% decode overhead over uniform 4-bit, with the caveat that this is an upper bound using PyTorch-level calls. The 27% PPL improvement on Qwen comes at the cost of both (a) a profiling step and (b) per-step mixed-precision dispatch overhead. For the four models where there is no PPL benefit, practitioners would pay this cost for nothing---hence the diagnostic is necessary. But the diagnostic itself requires the full profiling step, creating a chicken-and-egg problem: you need to profile to know if profiling was worthwhile.

- **W8. Missing discussion of the relationship to outlier-aware quantization methods.** RotateKV (cited but not discussed in depth) and SmoothQuant-style approaches address the same underlying problem---that certain components are more sensitive to quantization---through different mechanisms (rotation/smoothing rather than mixed-precision allocation). **Q2.** How sensitive is the diagnostic to the choice of top-5% cutoff and the 0.50/0.70 thresholds? If you use top-10% concentration instead, or shift the t1/t5 threshold to 0.65 or 0.75, does classification accuracy change? Given N=5, even a single reclassification would drop accuracy substantially.

If a practitioner must run the constrained solver for each candidate k AND evaluate calibration PPL, the total profiling + tuning cost may be substantial. Can you provide concrete numbers?

# Dream Review Report — ratekv (dream_20260515T085855)

**Paper**: "When Does Non-Uniform KV Cache Quantization Help? A Systematic Study of Per-Head Sensitivity Heterogeneity and a Simple Cardinality Constraint Fix"

**Review mode**: Full (2 Reviewers, 4-step roundtable)
**Date**: 2026-05-15

---

## Roundtable Process

- **R1** (Methods + Experiments): 4/6 → **5/6** after correcting N=1 misread
- **R2** (Novelty + Related Work): 4/6 → **4/6** maintained
- **Consensus score**: **4.5/6 (Borderline Accept)**

**Process note**: Both reviewers initially scored 4/6, largely anchored on a belief that the paper had N=1 for the Spread category (only Qwen2.5-7B). Upon verifying the review PDF, the paper unambiguously includes Qwen2.5-14B as the sixth model with full results (Tables 1–5, 7, 10–12), giving N=2 for each shape category. R1 upgraded to 5/6; R2 maintained 4/6, arguing same-family validation is architecturally insufficient.

---

## Paper Summary

The paper studies per-head mixed-precision KV cache quantization on hardware-aligned bit-widths {2,4,8,16} across six models (Qwen2.5-7B/14B, Yi-1.5-9B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Gemma-2-9B). It proposes a three-category shape taxonomy (Spread, Spike, Flat) of per-head sensitivity distributions and a two-metric empirical diagnostic (concentration ≥0.50 AND t₁/t₅ ≤0.70) that achieves 6/6 classification accuracy at both PPL and downstream task levels. The key finding is that unconstrained MCKP/greedy solvers fail catastrophically on Spread architectures (2.83–3.31× baseline) due to super-additive compounding, and a single cardinality constraint (≤k heads at 2-bit) suffices to prevent this, achieving 22–27% PPL improvement while making solver choice irrelevant (greedy = MCKP, Δ=0.0000).

---

## Consolidated Strengths

### S1. Clean problem decomposition and principled framework (R1, R2)
The profile → classify shape → constrain → solve pipeline is elegant, interpretable, and reproducible. Casting per-head allocation as MCKP with a cardinality constraint is well-motivated by the compounding failure mode.

### S2. Breadth and thoroughness of validation (R1, R2)
Six models across four architecture families, with constrained + unconstrained settings, k-ablation, downstream tasks (5 benchmarks), BOS fix validation, and cross-dataset stability. The 12 tables cover the experimental space comprehensively for a 9-page paper.

### S3. 14B held-out validation (R1, R2)
Profiling Qwen2.5-14B after thresholds were set on other models and confirming both shape classification (Spread) and allocation effectiveness (22% improvement) is a genuine generalization check that strengthens the diagnostic.

### S4. Solver equivalence result (R1, R2)
Demonstrating that constrained greedy = constrained MCKP (Δ=0.0000) across all tested models is a clean and practically useful result. Practitioners can use O(H log H) greedy without quality loss.

### S5. Honest self-assessment (R1, R2)
The paper explicitly acknowledges limitations (same-family Spread, no long-context eval, single-seed downstream) without overclaiming. The negative results (4/6 models show no benefit from non-uniform allocation) are reported without spin.

---

## Consolidated Weaknesses

### W1. Both Spread models are Qwen family [Major] (R1 #1, R2 #1)
Qwen2.5-7B and 14B share architecture, tokenizer, training recipe, and attention design (GQA, RoPE, SwiGLU). While 14B provides scale invariance evidence within Qwen, the paper lacks a non-Qwen Spread model. The diagnostic's ability to identify beneficial architectures outside the Qwen family is untested. A reviewer could argue N=2 within one family is effectively N=1 for architectural diversity.

**Impact**: This is the single most important weakness. It determines whether the paper is a generalizable methodology contribution or a Qwen-specific case study.

### W2. No comparison with concurrent mixed-precision KV methods [Major] (R2 #2)
KVTuner (ICML 2025), AquaKV, KVmix, and PM-KVQ are cited in related work but not benchmarked. Without head-to-head PPL comparisons on the same models, the practical advantage of per-head allocation over layer-level mixed-precision is unjudged except by qualitative argument (Appendix A.4 in the .tex sources, not in the review PDF).

**Impact**: Reviewers at a top venue will expect at least one concurrent baseline.

### W3. Super-additive compounding analysis is single-model [Moderate] (R2 #3, R1 #3)
The core mechanistic claim — that 2-bit head interactions cause super-additive degradation — is supported by the random-k vs top-k experiment (Table 8) on Qwen2.5-7B only. The U-shaped k-PPL curve (Table 7) is shown for 14B but the detailed compounding decomposition is not replicated on non-Qwen models. The three-tier taxonomy (Catastrophic/Moderate/Mild in Table 6) provides indirect evidence across models, but the formal proposition verification is N=1.

### W4. No downstream error bars or significance tests [Moderate] (R1 #5, R2 #4)
Downstream evaluation uses single-seed 0-shot. The reported deltas are small (+1.79pp for 14B, −0.48 to −0.99pp for non-Spread models). Without confidence intervals (minimum 3 seeds), some effects may be within noise. ARC-Challenge shows the largest sensitivity to allocation strategy but also the highest variance potential.

### W5. No long-context evaluation [Moderate] (R1 #4, R2 #5)
All PPL experiments use max_length=2048. KV cache quantization is most impactful at long sequences where memory pressure is real and attention patterns shift. Head sensitivity profiles may change at 4K–32K context lengths. The primary use case for this work is untested.

### W6. Minimal references in main paper [Minor] (R2)

### W7. Post-hoc threshold concern, partially mitigated [Minor] (R1 #8)
The diagnostic thresholds (concentration ≥0.50, t₁/t₅ ≤0.70) are derived from 6 data points with 2 free parameters. 14B as held-out partially mitigates overfitting concerns. No sensitivity analysis on threshold choice (e.g., what if 0.45 or 0.55 is used) is provided in the review PDF.

### W8. Cardinality constraint is conceptually straightforward [Minor] (R2 #9)
Capping the number of aggressively quantized components is a known technique in mixed-precision literature (HAWQ family). The contribution is applying it specifically to KV cache heads and demonstrating solver equivalence, which is clean engineering but limited novelty.
